name: HorrorCon Los Angeles
blurb: Horror-entertainment and celebrity convention at the Los Angeles Convention Center, with horror-film actors and themed stage shows.
notes: The 5th-anniversary edition ran June 13-14, 2026 (per the batch seed note), which already ended before the 2026-10-05 research window. The homepage (rendered 2026-10-05) still only shows that June 13-14, 2026 show (countdown timer expired at 00:00:00:00) with a promo offering 'Free Scream Ticket for 2027 if Your Birthday is on June 13 or 14 in 2026', but no actual 2027 dates anywhere. A WebSearch found no confirmed 2027 date either (past editions have landed in both June and September in different years, so the pattern isn't fixed); the LA Convention Center's own event-detail page for this show is stale (still shows 'October 1 - 2, 2022'), so it wasn't usable. Left editions empty until a next date is announced.
